a_oblique.class: missing side assignment at the exit face (band front f <= 0 is the plane through the edge perpendicular to d); contributing: support (relief-slot overhang sag ~1.1 mm, ~2 mm along d) and tool trajectory (4 mm overtravel)
a_oblique.evidence: s2201/s2202/s2203: 684/616/314 unassigned within 12 mm, all on the uphill side, only failing condition f > 0; decisive direct bridges 2/84/6 were behind the final edge in reference positions; relabelling them gives 2 components; sweep: law 8 fails from 25 deg (4 mm overtravel, 30 mm slot); 35 deg separates with 6 mm overtravel, a 12 mm slot or gravity off; plane phase 0-0.75 mm does not rescue it

b_rake45.class: unsupported cutting orientation: motion 45.0000006 deg out of the blade plane against theta_max = 45 deg (float32 decides); behind it class (c) core carry on s2307
b_rake45.evidence: s2307: gate closed on 120/120 segments for 17200 armed substeps, 0 labels, 13406 particle-substeps of cutting work with the gate closed; COUNTERFACTUAL theta_max 60: 24563 labels, 1 component from one carried apex particle (relabel -> 2); dome sweep: rho 10-44 separate (0.963-0.995), 45/46/50 give 0 labels, COUNTERFACTUAL 60 separates 45/50 (0.993/0.996)

c_residual.class: contact: core-band carry (particles inside |s| <= dx riding ahead of the edge are reachable by neither band nor lead); bumps3: contact lift plus code compatibility of chips cut by different digits
c_residual.evidence: s2501: 2 (p0) + 1 (p1) chip particles at z = H + 2.5 mm, closest approach f = +0.10..+0.43 mm, carried 39-80 mm; relabel -> 4 components; Test B s1502: 0 code-0 within 4 mm of its planes; bumps3: 49 substrate particles lifted 0.92-1.05 mm before assignment, chips carry codes 42/40/32

d_trim.class: contact (wedge/chip-load depression before the edge passes) at a lattice-phase margin (numerical resolution)
d_trim.evidence: TRIM-02-K2-R10: 45/316 lowest-layer particles pushed 0.47 mm down, s = -0.30 mm at assignment; substrate under the dome -0.36 mm median (P05 -1.73, min -2.12) vs -0.13 elsewhere; dome phase sweep: residue 1%/4%/7%/19%/98%/99% for gaps 0.5/0.4/0.3/0.2/0.1/0.0 mm

e_swept_normal.evidence: 0 flipped digits in every recorded run; F2.6 pure draw 904 draw digits used the solver's exact fallback; CPU generic-yaw pure draw 15/28 flips

classification.recommendation: Versioned law 9 = law 8 + breakthrough-gated lead (lead rule on plow_k OR B_k; B_k: no digit-0 particle in segment k's strip 0 < f <= 2dx, |s| <= dx while S = c+1) + relative swept-normal fallback (|m x e|^2 <= max(1e-20, (1e-5|m|)^2)); no new physical parameter; not implemented; must pass the full ADR 0006/A1 matrix, Phase F rows and new oblique / flat-board / bar-end rows before use. (b) envelope rho <= 44 deg declared; clearance-derived motion gate and a carried-material rule are separate candidate variants.
